headline: MILD RED / Fourth Consecutive Down Day
marketPulseNote: NEPSE closed mildly red on May 14, 2026 at 2730.17, down 10.07 points (-0.36%), marking the fourth consecutive down day since the May 11 high of 2783.84. Market breadth remained negative at 80 advances vs 174 declines vs 14 unchanged. Total turnover was Rs.3.29B with 7,958,752 shares across 46,402 transactions in 337 scrips — turnover recovered from yesterday's Rs.2.81B low. Broker 58 (Naasa Securities) remained a net buyer for the third consecutive session with purchases of NPR 242.10M vs sales of NPR 231.44M, net +Rs.10.66M. Key B58 activity: SMHL sold aggressively (83.52% of SMHL sell turnover) while HRL and SKHL were bought heavily. HRL dominated turnover at Rs.376.83M and was the biggest individual stock by transactions (5,508). Life Insurance (+0.01%), Mutual Fund (+0.08%) and Trading (+0.32%) were the only green sub-indices. UNHPL led gainers at +11.25% while AHL reversed yesterday's +11.42% gain with -9.89%.

keyInsights.title: SMHL B58 Sold 83.52% of Sell Side — Most Extreme Distribution in Dataset
keyInsights.body: B58 sold 58,254 kitta of SMHL constituting 83.52% of total SMHL sell turnover — the highest single-stock institutional distribution percentage observed across all three tracked sessions (May 12-14). This effectively means B58 controlled nearly all SMHL selling today. SMHL is near its 52W low zone. Strict avoidance warranted.

B58 has been net buyer for three straight days despite the market decline, suggesting institutional accumulation is underway at these levels.
